title: Battle Only Capture
description: Requires wild Pokémon to be captured during battle and removes wild opponents after the battle ends.
body:
## Initial release

- Wild Pokémon can only be captured while battling that exact Pokémon.
- Poké Balls thrown outside the correct battle are rejected and returned.
- Wild opponents are removed after victory, defeat, forfeiting, or fleeing.
- Fully server-authoritative and multiplayer compatible.
- Supports singleplayer through the integrated server.

### Requirements

- Minecraft 1.21.1
- Fabric
- Cobblemon 1.7.3
- Fabric API
